text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock merely to lock in a gain; I should decide whether holding or selling makes sense based on its prospects and my portfolio needs from today onward.","Average cost is a reference, not a reason to hold or sell. I should assess each position without letting pride, regret, or the desire to avoid realizing a loss drive the decision.","Doing nothing is also a choice, but I should review the portfolio deliberately rather than letting months of losses or short-term price moves dictate my actions; past changes do not predict future prices."]}
